scenes.text: Grok's new *voice AI* answers phones for *8 cents a minute*

scenes.title: What *changed*
lines: Oct 14: xAI released Grok Voice 3.0. Sub-second replies; it ranked first on the Artificial Analysis speech-to-speech index at 86.9.
Starlink's call centers run it: about 20,000 calls a day, roughly 70% resolved without a human.

scenes.title: The *money* use
lines: Build an AI receptionist for a local business: books appointments, answers hours, takes messages.
xAI's no-code Voice Agent Builder (July 2026) sets it up. Charge the business a monthly fee.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: Starlink's numbers are xAI's own. Test it on your own phone line before selling it to anyone.
You still need a phone-number provider on top. Source: xAI docs and Unite.AI, Oct 14, 2026.

scenes.title: The *cost*
lines: $0.08 a minute, same as Voice 2.0. That's $4.80 for an hour of calls.
A shop taking 200 minutes of calls a month pays about $16 in API fees.

scenes.text: Know a business that *misses calls*? Tag them below.
